LanguageData.APM_Hediff_SteelDiscipline.label: steel discipline
LanguageData.APM_Hediff_SteelDiscipline.description: Inspired by the Vassal's commanding presence, this unit moves and works with renewed purpose and mental fortitude. When the push ends, the strain catches up.
LanguageData.APM_Hediff_DisciplineBurnout.label: discipline burnout
LanguageData.APM_Hediff_DisciplineBurnout.description: Driven past a comfortable pace by the Vassal's discipline. Movement and work are sluggish until the strain wears off.
LanguageData.APM_Hediff_DisciplineBurnout_Mech.label: overdriven core
LanguageData.APM_Hediff_DisciplineBurnout_Mech.descri: Held at forced discipline for too long. The core runs hot: the mechanoid moves slower and drains its energy reserves faster until it settles.
